notes.title: Umfend is now available!
notes.notes:
Our new game Umfend is now out. Hope you'll enjoy it, although it's quite different from Fariwalk!

As for Fariwalk, we have plans for the future of the series and even an idea how to solve the problem with Prelude, but sadly, we can't announce anything now. We're extremely happy though that people are interested in the game. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/779090/Umfend/

notes.title: Our new game Umfend
notes.notes:
The Steam page of our new paid game is available now! 

It's an atmospheric horror game too, yet different from Fariwalk. While we will share more details about the future of Fariwalk series, we hope that our new project about love and time will be interesting for you too! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/779090/Umfend/

notes.title: 50% discount and other news
notes.notes:
We have a weekly deal for Fariwalk the Prelude. From 30th July to 6th August you can buy it with 50% discount.

We are aware of the fact that some players experience crashes, and we tried many things to fix it. However, it didn't work well, and now we think that probably it's necessary to rebuild the game from a scratch in order to fix it. We have some ideas on what we can do, and we'll try to arrange something in time for the launch of the next Fariwalk game. As for now, we'll make discounts more often.

If you experience a crash and you consider refunding, we suggest you to refund it right away. It's not likely that you'll be able to fix the problem on your own.

Also, please look forward to our new paid game, Umfend. We hope to launch it on Steam and itch.io in the coming two months!

notes.title: Discount and news
notes.notes:
On the next Steam sale (February 15-19), Fariwalk The Prelude will get a 30% discount (1,39$). We'll try to release a small patch before the sale, but unfortunately, due to technical difficulties, we can't say for sure. Also, Steam still doesn't allow us to add trading cards. Some brief news.

We have a Twitter account with news and screens: https://twitter.com/aihasto

We created a Patreon page if anyone wants to donate: https://www.patreon.com/aihasto

Now we are working on several projects, one of them will be free on Steam. We will make proper announcements later. The release of Fariwalk Episode I is planned on the second half of 2018.

notes.title: Release and plans
Release and plans
Release discount and other stuff
notes.notes:
Hello! We are very happy to present our first project on Steam, a short atmospheric horror adventure Fariwalk: The Prelude. It's a prologue to the main Fariwalk game that we plan to launch in 2018. We hope that you'll enjoy our little project and we're looking forward to any feedback! 

The price will be 1,99$ with some regional adjustments. To celebrate the launch, we'll provide a 15% discount during the first week. 

Also, there's a slight chance that some of you remember a free game Fariwalk: the Past. The Prelude is basically a reworked and extended version of the Past with new quests, characters, things to explore, altered main story, music and other tweaks. We worked hard to justify the conversion from a free project into a paid one, so we hope that even those who already played the previous version will find enough new interesting stuff!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31006485/6fd012b2aee1f594c1103912150215d9476f975d.png[/img]
